_readme: LIVE onboarding config for SpeedShield b50/v21+. Editing this file changes the fresh-install onboarding cards (count, order, template, copy, colors, images) and the trial reminder (day_offset, title, body) on users' next launch — no app release. The app validates before rendering and falls back to its bundled default on any parse error, so a bad edit degrades gracefully; still, keep edits to valid JSON. Templates available: hero_moment, features, timeline. Icons: bluetooth, map, update, volume, unlock, bell, star, shield, car, camera, navigation, check. Prices are never configured here — they render from store product data. If you change reminder.day_offset, update the 'Day N' timeline text to match.

reminder._note: day_offset drives the ACTUAL notification (fires day_offset days after trial start, same time of day the trial began; clamped 1-6). If you change it, also update the 'Day N' timeline card text above so the promise matches the delivery.
